verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect. The docs say new features ship behind feature flags with alpha features off by default, which implies some feature-maturity tiering. They also offer separate stable and pre-release (master) Helm channels. Neither amounts to a documented compatibility promise or an upgrade guide. Missing for 10: an explicit API/version compatibility or deprecation policy, documented upgrade guides between releases, and independent corroboration that upgrades go smoothly.
